translation.可选：仅部分 JWT 登录方式需要客户端 ID: Optional: only some JWT login methods require a client ID
translation.可选：基于用户信息 JSON 做组合条件准入，条件不满足时返回自定义提示: Optional: combined-condition admission based on the user info JSON; a custom message is returned when the condition is not met
translation.可选：用于自动生成端点或 Discovery URL: Optional: used to auto-generate endpoints or the Discovery URL
translation.可选。匹配入口请求的 User-Agent；任意一行作为子串匹配（忽略大小写）即: Optional. Matches the User-Agent of the entry request; any line matching as a substring (case-insensitive) counts as a hit.
translation.可选。对提取到的亲和 Key 做正则校验；不填表示不校验。: Optional. Validates the extracted affinity Key with a regex; blank means no validation.
translation.可选。对请求路径进行匹配；不填表示匹配所有路径。: Optional. Matches the request path; blank means match all paths.
translation.合格失败已开始或续期冷却，影响相同分组和模型的后续请求。: A qualifying failure started or renewed cooldown for matching requests.

translation.后台暂无 npm 版本记录，已使用内置版本列表: No npm version record in the backend yet; the built-in version list is used

translation.启用 Codex Responses 流式推理截断续写折叠。默认关闭，仅作用于: Enable Codex Responses streaming continuation folding after reasoning token truncation. Disabled by default and limited to Codex SSE.

translation.启用SSRF防护（推荐开启以保护服务器安全）: Enable SSRF Protection (Recommended for server security)
translation.启用后可接入 io.net GPU 资源: After enabling, you can access io.net GPU resources
translation.启用后可添加图片URL进行多模态对话: After enabling, you can add image URLs for multimodal conversations
translation.启用后套餐将在用户端展示。是否继续？: After enabling, the plan will be shown to users. Continue?

translation.启用后将使用 Creem Test Mode: Use Creem Test Mode after enabling
translation.启用后将使用 Waffo 沙盒环境: When enabled, the Waffo sandbox environment is used
translation.启用性能监控后，当系统资源使用率超过设定阈值时，将拒绝新的 Relay 请求 (: When performance monitoring is enabled and system resource usage exceeds the set threshold, new Relay requests (/v1, /v1beta, etc.) will be rejected to protect system stability.
translation.启用此模式后，将使用您自定义的请求体发送API请求，模型配置面板的参数设置将被忽: After enabling this mode, your custom request body will be used to send API requests, and parameter settings in the model configuration panel will be ignored.
translation.启用用户模型请求速率限制（可能会影响高并发性能）: Enable user model request rate limit (may affect high concurrency performance)
translation.启用磁盘缓存后，大请求体将临时存储到磁盘而非内存，可显著降低内存占用，适用于处理: When enabled, large request bodies are temporarily stored on disk instead of memory, significantly reducing memory usage. Suitable for requests with large images/files. SSD recommended.
translation.命中判定：usage 中存在 cached tokens（例如 cached_t: Hit determination: a cache hit is counted when cached tokens exist in usage (e.g. cached_tokens/prompt_cache_hit_tokens).
translation.命中该亲和规则后，会把此模板合并到渠道参数覆盖中（同名键由模板覆盖）。: When this affinity rule is hit, this template is merged into the channel parameter override (same-name keys are overridden by the template).
translation.和Claude不同，默认情况下Gemini的思考模型会自动决定要不要思考，就算不: Unlike Claude, Gemini thinking models automatically decide whether to think by default. They work normally even without the adapter enabled. If you need billing, set the price of models without suffix to the thinking price. Use format like gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05-thinking-128 to specify exact thinking budget.
translation.响应中 JWT 字段路径（可选）: JWT field path in the response (optional)
translation.响应缺少授权链接: Response is missing the authorization link
translation.固定客户端标识；默认不自动补透传，严格复刻上游链路时再按需补 pass_head: Static client identity. By default it does not add passthrough automatically. Add pass_headers only when you need to reproduce the upstream request path strictly.
translation.固定模式下点击其他模板会直接替换当前选择: In fixed mode, clicking another template directly replaces the current selection.
translation.固定模式只使用一个模板，重新选择会直接替换: Fixed mode uses only one template; reselecting replaces it directly
translation.固定模式只保留一个模板，重新选择会直接替换: Fixed mode keeps one template. Selecting another template replaces the current one.
translation.固定模式必须且只能选择 1 个客户端模板: Fixed mode requires exactly 1 client template to be selected
translation.固定模式必须且只能选择 1 个请求头模板: Fixed mode must select exactly 1 header template
translation.固定请求头只用于普通渠道标识；Claude 官方客户端链路如需保留会话与 SDK: Static headers are only for normal channel identification. Claude official-client flows that need session and SDK metadata still require enabling the Claude Code passthrough template in Advanced Parameter Override.
translation.固定请求头只用于普通渠道标识；Codex 官方客户端限制场景还必须在高级参数覆盖: Static headers are only for normal channel identification. Codex official-client restriction scenarios still require enabling the Codex CLI passthrough template in Advanced Parameter Override.
translation.固定请求头用于普通渠道标识。Gemini CLI 在部分认证或统计场景还会附加额: Static headers are for normal channel identification. Gemini CLI may attach extra headers in some authentication or usage-statistics flows. If the upstream needs a strict real-client request shape, add passthrough rules in Advanced Settings.
translation.固定请求头静态快照按 Claude Code 2.1.197 公开 latest: Static headers use the public latest Claude Code 2.1.197 version with the existing client UA format. This template only fixes client identity. Dynamic headers such as X-Claude-Code-Session-Id, Anthropic-Version, Anthropic-Beta, and X-Stainless-* must be enabled explicitly with the Claude Code header passthrough template in Advanced Parameter Override.
translation.固定请求头静态快照按 Droid 0.161.0 公开 latest 版本套用既: Static headers use the public latest Droid 0.161.0 version with the existing client UA format. This template only fixes client identity. X-Stainless-* dynamic headers must be enabled explicitly with the Droid CLI header passthrough template in Advanced Parameter Override.
translation.固定请求头静态快照按 Gemini CLI 0.49.0 公开 latest 版: Static headers use the public latest Gemini CLI 0.49.0 version with the existing client UA format. This template only fixes client identity. Dynamic headers such as x-goog-api-client must be enabled explicitly with the Gemini CLI header passthrough template in Advanced Parameter Override.
translation.固定请求头静态快照按 Qwen Code 0.19.3 公开 latest 版本: Static headers use the public latest Qwen Code 0.19.3 version with the existing client UA format. This template only fixes client identity. x-stainless-* dynamic headers must be enabled explicitly with the Qwen Code header passthrough template in Advanced Parameter Override.
translation.固定请求头静态快照来自 Codex CLI 0.130.0 交互式 TUI 请求: Static headers come from the Codex CLI 0.130.0 interactive TUI header generation logic. This template only fixes client identity. Session, window, and turn metadata dynamic headers must be enabled explicitly with the Codex CLI header passthrough template in Advanced Parameter Override.
translation.固定请求头静态快照来自 Codex CLI 0.142.4 交互式 TUI 请求: Static headers come from the Codex CLI 0.142.4 interactive TUI header generation logic. This template only fixes client identity. translation.固定请求头静态快照来自本机 Codex Desktop App 26.623.7: Static headers come from the local Codex Desktop App 26.623.70822. Session, window, and turn metadata dynamic headers must be enabled explicitly with the Codex Desktop header passthrough template in Advanced Parameter Override.
translation.固定请求头静态快照来自本机 Qwen Code 0.15.10 的 OpenAI: Static headers come from local Qwen Code 0.15.10 OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions requests. This template only fixes client identity. x-stainless-* dynamic headers must be enabled explicitly with the Qwen Code header passthrough template in Advanced Parameter Override.
translation.固定请求头静态快照来自本机实抓 Claude Code 2.1.139 /v1/: Static headers come from a local capture of Claude Code 2.1.139 /v1/messages?beta=true. This template only fixes client identity. Dynamic headers such as X-Claude-Code-Session-Id, Anthropic-Version, Anthropic-Beta, and X-Stainless-* must be enabled explicitly with the Claude Code header passthrough template in Advanced Parameter Override.
translation.固定请求头静态快照来自本机实抓 Droid 0.123.0 的 OpenAI-c: Static headers come from a local capture of Droid 0.123.0 OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions. This template only fixes client identity. X-Stainless-* dynamic headers must be enabled explicitly with the Droid CLI header passthrough template in Advanced Parameter Override.
translation.固定请求头静态快照来自本机实抓 Gemini CLI 0.41.2 的 stre: Static headers come from a local capture of Gemini CLI 0.41.2 streamGenerateContent. This template only fixes client identity. Dynamic headers such as x-goog-api-client must be enabled explicitly with the Gemini CLI header passthrough template in Advanced Parameter Override.

### High-Risk Operation: Risk Notice and Disclaimer for 504/524 Retry
By default, this project does not retry for status codes `400` (bad request), `504` (gateway timeout), and `524` (timeout occurred).
 In many cases, 504 and 524 mean the request has reached the upstream AI service and processing has started, but the connection was closed due to long processing time.

Enabling redirection/retry for these timeout status codes is a **high-risk operation**. Before enabling it, you must read and understand the consequences below:

#### 1. Core Risks (Read Carefully)
1. Duplicate/multiple billing risk: Most upstream AI providers **still charge** for requests that started processing but got interrupted by network timeout (504/524). If retry is triggered, a new upstream request will be sent, which can lead to **duplicate or multiple charges**.
2. Severe client timeout: If a single request already timed out, adding retries can multiply total latency and cause severe or unacceptable timeout behavior for your final client/caller.
3. Request backlog and system crash risk: Forcing retries on timeout requests keeps threads and connections occupied for longer. Under high concurrency, this can cause serious backlog, exhaust system resources, trigger a cascading failure, and crash your proxy service.

#### 2. Risk Acknowledgement
If you still choose to enable this feature, you acknowledge all of the following:
